jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established and specialized company operating in the field of machinery and railway equipment. They are known for their dynamic SME environment and strong team collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The Internal Sales Representative plays a key role in supporting the sales team by managing quotations, processing orders, and ensuring smooth communication between customers, suppliers, and internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive and handle price requests via email, phone, and other channels
• Request quotations from suppliers and negotiate pricing and conditions with the Sales Director
• Prepare and send customer quotations
• Enter offers and orders into the ERP system (knowledge of Navision or Business Central is a strong asset)
• Follow up on ongoing quotations in collaboration with the sales team
• Monitor and manage ongoing orders (delivery timelines, framework agreements)
• Handle customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions
• Send payment reminders when required
• Collaborate closely with the administrative team
• Support the preparation of trade shows and exhibitions
• Assist in preparing orders and coordinating shipments
• Ensure electronic registration of warehouse entries and exits
• Participate in inventory counts when needed
• Provide occasional support in the warehouse (receiving and shipping goods)

Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
• Previous experience in a back-office or order processing role
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Trilingual: Dutch / French and English or German
• Detail-oriented, stress-resistant, and versatile
• Reliable, consistent, and commercially minded

Nice to have:

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or VCA standards

• Our client is a leading European consumer services organization operating across multiple international markets.
• Recognized for its customer-centric approach, the company continuously invests in service excellence, operational efficiency and process improvement.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor and assess customer interactions and service quality performance to identify trends, gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Design, coordinate and manage customer experience assessment programs, including quality audits and mystery shopping initiatives across multiple countries.
• Analyze customer feedback, operational performance metrics and quality data to support informed decision-making. 
• Map and evaluate customer journeys across channels, identifying friction points and recommending practical improvement actions.
• Collaborate with operational and regional stakeholders to support the implementation of service quality and customer experience initiatives.
• Prepare insightful reports, dashboards and presentations for leadership teams, translating data into clear business recommendations.

• Bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Operational Excellence, Business Analysis or a related field.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and transform insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
• Able to work autonomously in a cross-functional environment.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Flexible to travel across Europe (approximately 20%).

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.
 

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.
 

Responsibilities:
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities: 
 

 
• you take ownership
 
• you guide and support others confidently
 
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way 
 

 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

As an operator, you work together with your colleagues to operate computer-controlled machines. You set the correct parameters, perform checks, and make sure the production process runs smoothly.
Your day involves setting up machines, performing quality checks, and packaging products. You work in a shift system and actively contribute ideas for improvements.
Interested in joining an innovative team where you can grow? Apply now!

• Preferably, you already have relevant experience in a production environment

• Working in a continuous shift system appeals to you

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• Motivated and eager to learn

• Team player who takes initiative

Do you enjoy working with a forklift and appreciate order? This forklift operator position allows you to support the entire production process. 

You make sure raw materials and finished products are always in the right place to keep operations running smoothly.Your typical day starts by checking your forklift. You supply the necessary materials according to the production schedule and safely store finished goods in the designated locations.

Does this job sound interesting? Apply quickly and make a difference as a forklift operator!

• You have experience as a forklift operator or in a similar role
• You speak fluent Dutch, English, or French
• You work safely and precisely
• You take initiative to report problems or defects
• You are willing to work in two shifts

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

For a meat processing company in Zele, we are looking for motivated Production Workers to join their team.

Are you physically strong and enjoy working in a dynamic environment? 
Then this job is definitely for you! 
 
Responsibilities

 
• 
Responsible for unloading trucks

 
• 
Placing pork on the production line and ensuring smooth workflow

 
• 
Trimming meat where needed to get products in the correct shape

 
• 
Alternating between all the above tasks – no day is the same

 
• 
Starting in the early morning (between 3:30 AM and 4:30 AM) and working until the job is completed

 
• 
Working in a cooled environment of approximately 7°C

 
• 
A physical, varied job in a production environment appeals to you

 
• 
Early mornings are not a problem for you

 
• 
You are a team player and contribute to efficient production

 
• 
You are flexible and willing to work until the job is done

 
• 
Experience in production or logistics

 
• 
Experience in the food sector is a plus

 
• 
Comfortable working in a cooled environment of 7°C

 
• 
Fluent in English and/or Dutch and/or Romanian

 
• 
You have your own transport

As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

Are you a true foodie who has always dreamed of a job in the food industry?
 

Do you have experience in production and are you ready to turn your passion for snacks into a career? Then we are looking for you!

Passion for good food.

Willingness to work nights (9 p.m. to 5 a.m.).
 
 
•  
Fluency in English.

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the events industry, specialising in the design and manufacture of exhibition stand systems. The company is renowned for its innovative approach and high-quality products, which are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions and events.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

As a Production Technician, you will provide technical support within an automated production environment, with a 50/50 split between mechanical and electrical work. You will troubleshoot, analyse and resolve technical faults on a varied range of machinery, including CNC machines, robots, milling and sawing machines, while also carrying out preventive maintenance and implementing improvements together with the Technical Manager. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, as well as thorough training and ongoing support in a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

Responsibilities

In this role as a Python ERP Developer, you take charge of the continuous evolution of internal business applications.

• Develop and refine custom features within the Odoo platform to streamline core operational processes.
• Connect software tools using clean API integrations and database structures to ensure accurate reporting.
• Troubleshoot technical issues quickly to maintain smooth daily workflows or coordinate with external development partners.
• Translate feedback from users in the field into clear technical specifications and practical solutions.
• Manage the internal reporting platform to guarantee overall system integration and data integrity.

 

     
Profile

For the position of Python ERP Developer, we are looking for a developer with a few years under their belt who combines analytical thinking with clear communication skills.

• Proven proficiency in Python and familiarity with other programming languages like .NET (ideally 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar role).
• Demonstrable experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP package is a major advantage.
• Colleagues describe you as a pragmatic problem solver who easily explains complex tech concepts to non-technical users.
• You speak English or French fluently, with at least a practical working knowledge of Dutch (or a strong willingness to learn).

What are your responsibilities?

 
• 
You manage urgent orders from start to finish

 
• 
You discuss and follow up special orders and customer requests

 
• 
You work closely with internal and external partners in the supply chain

 
• 
You give advice about logistics and commercial solutions

 
• 
You help improve processes and ways of working

 
• 
You use new tools and technologies to support improvements

 
• 
You think about better ways of working and suggest changes

 
• 
You work together with different teams and support change

 
• 
You solve problems in a structured way and keep a high service level

Who are we looking for?

 
• 
You speak English, French and Italian very well

 
• 
Knowledge of Spanish is a plus

 
• 
You are customer-focused and service-minded

 
• 
You communicate easily and like to build a network

 
• 
You can organize your work and set priorities

 
• 
You are interested in improvements and new technologies

 
• 
You have good knowledge of Office 365

 
• 
Knowledge of SharePoint or PowerBI is a plus

 
• 
You are available from May until the end of September (with possible extension)
